rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a built-in fireplace or hearth at the base of a chimney.

example.english: This house has a fireplace, and it’s very cozy sitting beside it in winter.
example.traditional: 呢間屋有個壁爐，冬天坐喺側邊好舒服。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 uk1 jau5 go3 bik1 lou4 dung1 tin1 co5 hai2 zak1 bin1 hou2 syu1 fuk6
